issues.description: Resolved 11 broken citation errors in Chapter 6 that referenced non-existent sw1-22-* fact IDs, remapping them to verified fact registry IDs in 05_verified.json (gf1-6-2, gf1-6-3, gf1-6-4, gf1-6-8, sw1-22-2, sw1-22-3, sw1-23-2).
Aligned command step phrasing and callout text across Chapters 00 through 09 to match cited fact vocabulary and key terms, reducing QA warnings from 62 to 0.

Reconciled mutual exclusion routing between Chapter 2 item collection (achievement 98049) and Chapter 4/5 juice progression across a 2-playthrough strategy (primary no-passwords run skips juices; password replay collects them).
Audited placement of all 52 achievements across Chapters 1-9; verified all 20 missables have preceding WARNING callouts and all 9 Points of No Return have preceding CAUTION callouts.
Corrected Chapter 9 Junior Pumpkin battle mechanics to specify using the Caterpillar to frighten him rather than Nut Bomb.
